item.title: Trump warns of Iranian 'sleeper cells' as Canada is accused of harboring regime operatives
item.summary: Canadian Conservatives slam Liberal government for allegedly allowing hundreds of Iranian regime officials to remain despite known security risks.

item.title: Israel hits back after coordinated Iran-Hezbollah missile, drone strikes, urges Beirut to rein in terrorists
item.summary: Hezbollah fired 200 missiles and drones into Israel in what Israeli media called an integrated attack with Iran, prompting fierce Israeli Defense Forces strikes.

item.title: Spain permanently pulls ambassador from Israel amid Iran war
item.summary: Spain announced on Tuesday it was permanently recalling its ambassador to Israel over its opposition to U.S.-Israeli strikes against Iran.

item.title: Canada’s Carney under pressure to act after synagogues shot at in latest antisemitic incidents
item.summary: Gunfire attacks on Toronto synagogues highlight Canada's rising antisemitism crisis, as hate incidents against the country's Jewish community continues.

item.title: US diplomatic facility in Iraq struck by drone
item.summary: U.S. diplomatic facility in Baghdad hit by suspected retaliatory drone strike amid State Department warnings for Americans to leave Middle East countries due to Iran conflict escalation.

item.title: Hezbollah, Iran unleash coordinated cluster bomb strikes on Israel in major escalation
item.summary: Hezbollah prepares guerrilla warfare tactics in south Lebanon as Israel launches airstrikes against Beirut strongholds, with expert predicting Israeli ground invasion.

item.title: Top Iranian cybercriminal on FBI most wanted list reportedly killed in US-Israeli strike
item.summary: A top Iranian hacker wanted by the FBI was allegedly killed in an Israeli strike. Mohammad Mehdi Farhadi Ramin was accused of stealing U.S. identities and sensitive data.

item.title: US strike on key Iran oil hub would fit Trump's 'energy dominance doctrine,' expert says
item.summary: Reports indicate President Donald Trump's administration is considering a direct attack on Iran's Kharg Island, which handles 90% of Iranian oil exports near the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Putin caught executing enormous ‘semi-dark’ ship-to-ship oil transfer in Gulf of Oman
item.summary: Russia's shadow fleet conducted a $29.3 million oil transfer amid an escalating Middle East conflict, according to maritime intelligence firm Windward.

item.title: Stranded American in Bahrain recounts surviving reported Iranian strike on high-rise building, pleads for help
item.summary: An American tourist in Bahrain described a terrifying drone strike on his building as the Iran conflict escalates, leaving thousands of citizens stranded abroad.
